craft_notes: Sthāyin: site-joy. Close: sameness. Rejected: 'chakras' — killed: sites kept.

lines: undoubted comes — crown, face, heart, secret, form the same.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā bhavaty asaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā | mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye murtau tathaiva ca

reads_against.argmap: Initiation becomes undoubted, oblation-free — on crown, face, heart, hidden, form.
c1_essence: Undoubted oblation-free initiation on five sites.
